command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('AGG_SW_04','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','FW_01','PE1','PE2','PE3','SZ_AR'); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ `$ub='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$u5='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_05/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; try{`$a=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$ub -Method Get).output -split '\r?\n'; `$b=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u5 -Method Get).output -split '\r?\n'; Write-Output ('NODE='+`$n); Compare-Object -ReferenceObject `$a -DifferenceObject `$b | ForEach-Object { Write-Output (`$_.SideIndicator+' '+`$_.InputObject) }}catch{Write-Output ('ERR='+`$n)}}"
